title: Subject:
prompt:
Subject: 
Morning stretch on tatami mats

Main Subject: 
A young adult woman sitting on tatami mats in a bright Japanese-style room with morning sunlight coming through the shoji screens, stretching with her legs raised high. The figure is placed large in the center of the screen, focusing on her frontal face, bent legs, soles aligned to the upper left, and hands supporting her legs.

Person/Expression: 
Small oval face, bright smooth skin, large dark brown eyes, thin natural eyebrows, small nose, and pale pink lips. Facing the frontal camera with a friendly, closed-mouth smile. Long eyelashes, thin eyeliner, and distinct peach-colored flush on both cheeks. Dark brown hair, almost black, tied in a messy bun high at the back, leaving thin bangs and thin wisps of hair along the cheeks.

Clothing/Pose: 
Ivory fine rib fabric short strap top with small lace edges and a central lace-up ribbon, black soft flared mini skirt, barefoot. Sitting on the tatami, knees deeply bent and raised high in front of the chest, ankles crossed with soles pointing towards the upper left. Right arm wrapped around the front of the left shin, left hand supporting the leg, upper body visible between the thighs.

Background/Lighting: 
White wooden-framed shoji screens on the left, light brown tatami floor with green borders. A low wooden storage shelf in the back right, a transparent narrow-neck vase with green branches, and a white framed botanical print above. Warm direct morning light enters diagonally from the shoji on the left, softly illuminating the face, shoulders, thighs, and soles, casting soft window frame shadows on the tatami. Diffused light from the white walls fills the shadow side.

Composition/Camera: 
Vertical 3:4. A close-up, near full-body seated portrait captured from a low camera near the tatami floor. The waist and bent legs occupy the lower half, the face is in the upper half to the right, and the crossed soles are in the upper left. The skirt hem is near the bottom edge, and toes are near the top edge. Sharp focus on face, legs, hands, and feet with medium depth of field showing the Japanese room background.

Texture/Style: 
High-definition photorealistic live-action photograph taken in warm morning natural light. Realistic depiction of natural skin texture, stray hairs, ribbed top and lace, black cloth, fingers and soles, tatami weave, shoji paper, wood, and glass vase. A calm color scheme of light wood, white, and black, avoiding excessive skin smoothing or illustrative styles.

Negative: 
Alteration of crossed legs, soles, hand support, facial features, or bun hair.
